questions.question: An icon-only Pressable shows a star. What makes it understandable to TalkBack and VoiceOver users?
options: Nothing — screen readers describe icons automatically
Adding accessibilityRole="button" and an accessibilityLabel such as "Add to watchlist"
questions.explanation: RN views have no implicit semantics. Role says what the element is, label says what to read, and accessibilityState conveys selected/disabled status.

questions.question: What are the commonly cited minimum touch target sizes?
options: 44×44 pt on iOS (Apple HIG) and 48×48 dp on Android (Material)
questions.explanation: Small icons can keep their visual size while expanding the touchable area with hitSlop.

questions.question: Your app calls `I18nManager.forceRTL(true)` when the user picks Arabic. Why doesn't the layout flip immediately?
options: Layout direction is read at startup, so the app must be reloaded for it to take effect
questions.explanation: RTL direction is applied at app start; a reload (for example Updates.reloadAsync in Expo) is needed after changing it.

questions.question: What does `new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR" }).format(1234567.5)` produce?
questions.explanation: The en-IN locale uses the Indian grouping system (lakh/crore) and the ₹ symbol, with two decimal places for INR.
